data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Iordanes, meaning 'downflowing' or 'running through'. In the Bible, Jordan is the name of a river that symbolizes baptism and crossing into a new life. Jordyn may represent a feminine connection to this spiritual journey. The name Jordyn carries the meaning “Jordan's daughter” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jordyn usually hope their child will grow to embody jordan's daughter and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jordyn total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
